items.name: bed_a
items.text: Warm premium lo-fi study background music for a motivational education video: soft felt piano and warm electric piano chords, gentle plucked guitar, light brushed beat around 100 BPM, subtle warm pad. Calm, hopeful and focused, sparse arrangement that sits under a fast Chinese female voiceover. No vocals, no big drops, no sudden changes.
